DocPII: Contextual Redaction Benchmark Dataset
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

DocPII contains 1101 high-quality document samples enriched with embedded personally identifiable information (PII). Designed to evaluate context-aware redaction systems, it provides realistic, full-document contexts—a notable advancement over sentence-level datasets.
All documents have been manually reviewed for accuracy, coherence, and redaction alignment, ensuring data quality for benchmarking and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nutrientdocs/DocPII-redaction-benchmark.
reputation: Relatively new, gaining attention for document-level, context-aware PII redaction evaluation but still niche compared to sentence-level NER datasets.
